appDescription.message: Automatically finds and tries real discount codes at online store checkouts. Uses affiliate links in partner stores: if you buy through them we may earn a commission, at no extra cost to you.

widgetMessage.message: We have %COUPONS% saved for this store. We can try them right now.

statusBestCode.message: ✅ Best code: %CODE%. You save approx. %AMOUNT% compared to the initial price.

statusApplied.message: We applied code %CODE%. Check the discount in your cart.

statusNoConfirm.message: We tried %COUNT% code(s), but couldn't confirm the savings automatically. Check your cart.

popupEmptyCoupons.message: We don't have coupons for this store yet. Be the first to add one!

popupAddSectionTitle.message: Know a code that works here?

popupHintShared.message: Your coupon is shared with the rest of the extension's users.

popupHintLocal.message: For now it's saved only in your browser (shared backend not configured yet).

popupErrorInvalidCode.message: That code doesn't look right — use only letters, numbers, spaces or dashes (2–40 characters).

popupErrorInvalidDesc.message: The description can't be longer than 140 characters or contain links.

popupErrorRateLimited.message: You've added several coupons in a short time — try again a bit later.

popupErrorGeneric.message: Couldn't save the coupon, try again in a moment.

onboardingIntro.message: It automatically tries real discount codes whenever you reach an online store's cart. Here's how it works:

onboardingStep1Body.message: Shop as usual. As soon as you land on a store's cart or checkout page, the extension detects it on its own.

onboardingStep2Body.message: If we have coupons saved for that store, a small floating prompt appears. Tap "Try coupons".

onboardingStep3Body.message: The extension tries each code in the background and leaves the one that lowers the price the most applied, showing you how much you saved.

onboardingTransparencyBody.message: In stores where we have an affiliate program, using the extension records your visit in our favor at no extra cost to you — the price you pay never changes. You can turn this off anytime in Settings.

optionsStatusBackendOn.message: Active — your coupons are shared with the community

optionsStatusBackendOff.message: Inactive — coupons you add are saved only in this browser

optionsAffiliateToggleLabel.message: Allow affiliate tagging on partner stores

optionsAffiliateToggleBody.message: When on, visiting a store with an affiliate program configured records the visit in our favor in the background (no redirect, no change to the price you pay). Turn it off if you'd rather the extension work purely as a coupon finder.

optionsClearDataLabel.message: Clear data saved in this browser

optionsClearDataBody.message: Removes the coupons you contributed and the price history that were saved only locally (doesn't affect what the community shares).

optionsClearDataConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to clear your locally saved data (coupons and price history)? This can't be undone.

optionsClearDataDone.message: Done — your local data has been cleared.

optionsPriceRadarToggleBody.message: When on, visiting a product page records its price (locally, and also in the shared database if configured) so we can warn you if it went up before a sale, if it's the lowest price seen recently, or if the same product is cheaper at another store (when the page itself exposes a barcode or brand+part number). We store the price, the product page, and that code or brand+part number when available — never personal data.

priceRadarUpMessage.message: This product went up ~%PERCENT%% over the last 30 days (was: %PRICE%). The coupon may just be covering up that increase.

priceRadarLowMessage.message: This is the lowest price we've seen for this product in the last 30 days.

priceRadarCheaperElsewhereMessage.message: This same product is ~%PERCENT%% cheaper at %STORE%.

popupAffiliateNotice.message: 🔗 We use affiliate links in partner stores

widgetAffiliateNote.message: If you buy here, we may earn an affiliate commission — this never changes what you pay.

legalPageTitle.message: Privacy & affiliate programs — Cazadora de Cupones

legalIntro.message: Cazadora de Cupones automatically finds and tries discount codes when you reach an online store's cart. This page explains how the extension is funded and what data it handles.

legalAffiliateBody.message: In stores where we have an affiliate program, the extension automatically registers your visit with the affiliate network (for example Awin), without redirecting you anywhere. If you end up buying, we may earn a small commission from the store. This never changes the price you pay or adds any cost. You can turn this off at any time in Settings, using the "Allow affiliate tagging in partner stores" toggle.

legalDataBody.message: The coupons you contribute and, if you enable the price radar, the price history you see are stored in your browser and, optionally, in a shared backend so other people can benefit from them. We do not sell your data to third parties. You can delete your local data at any time from Settings.
